embedding.title: NV-Embed: Improved Techniques for Training LLMs as Generalist Embedding Models
embedding.why: Decoder-only LLM as embedding backbone. Topped MTEB for over a year.

embedding.title: GritLM: Generative Representational Instruction Tuning
embedding.why: Single model that does both generation and embeddings. Opens design space beyond specialists.

embedding.title: Linq-Embed-Mistral Technical Report
embedding.why: Strong open retrieval model; beats most APIs on MTEB-retrieval (60.2).

embedding.title: Late Chunking: Contextual Chunk Embeddings Using Long-Context Embedding Models
embedding.why: Apply transformer to full doc, chunk *after* — preserves cross-chunk context. Now in Jina v3.

embedding.title: Jina-ColBERT-v2: A General-Purpose Multilingual Late Interaction Retriever
embedding.why: Multilingual late-interaction; proves the approach still works if you need fine-grained scoring.

rag.title: Don't Do RAG: When Cache-Augmented Generation Is All You Need for Knowledge Tasks
rag.why: The 'CAG' paper. Preload corpus into KV cache; query against cached state. Works for ≤1M tokens.

rag.title: Enhancing Cache-Augmented Generation with Adaptive Contextual Compression
rag.why: Extends CAG with selective compression. Pushes the corpus-size ceiling.

rag.title: Agentic Retrieval-Augmented Generation: A Survey
rag.why: Definitive overview of how RAG became a tool inside agents instead of a pipeline. 34→89% jumps on multi-hop.

rag.title: Lost in the Middle: How Language Models Use Long Contexts
rag.why: The original problem statement. Models forget the middle of long contexts. Still true in 2026 — Opus 4.7 regressed on this.

rag.title: RULER: What's the Real Context Size of Your Long-Context Language Models?
rag.why: Benchmark beyond simple needle-in-haystack. Most models with 1M-token windows score much lower than they advertise.

rag.title: Beyond RAG vs. Long-Context: Distraction-Aware Retrieval
rag.why: Argues neither pure-RAG nor pure-long-context is correct; retrieval should learn to ignore distractors.

tagging.title: Prototypical Networks for Few-Shot Learning
tagging.why: Old but load-bearing. Class as centroid in embedding space. Best baseline for low-label regimes.

tagging.title: Recent Advances in Hierarchical Multi-Label Text Classification: A Survey
tagging.why: Reference for the multi-tier tagging problem; surveys tree, flat-with-constraints, and contrastive approaches.

tagging.title: Evaluation of Embedding-Based and Generative Methods for LLM-Driven Document Classification
tagging.why: Hybrid stack benchmark — embedding-classifier + LLM-fallback on ambiguous cases. Cuts LLM cost ~95%.

evaluation.title: RAGAS: Automated Evaluation of Retrieval Augmented Generation
evaluation.why: The reference for reference-free RAG eval. Faithfulness / context precision / context recall / answer relevance. Still SOTA in 2026 with v1.2 dynamic recalibration.

evaluation.title: eRAG: Redefining Retrieval Evaluation in the Era of LLMs
evaluation.why: Utility-based: score each doc by running RAG with only that doc. 50× lower GPU memory than full RAG eval; higher Kendall's τ.

evaluation.title: RAG Evaluation in the Era of LLMs: Survey
evaluation.why: LLM-as-judge has become 2× more prevalent than traditional metrics. Surveys failure modes.

evaluation.title: Case-Aware LLM-as-Judge for Enterprise RAG
evaluation.why: Calibration: label 50–100 manually, measure judge TPR/TNR, correct raw scores. Practical.

memory.title: From Human Memory to AI Memory: A Survey
memory.why: Lilian Weng et al. The reference framing for episodic vs semantic vs procedural memory in agents. Includes the privacy attack: 69% attribute leakage from episodic memory.

memory.title: Cognitive Architectures for Language Agents (CoALA)
memory.why: Princeton/CMU. Formalizes consolidation: how episodic events become semantic patterns. Foundational for 'dreaming.'
